program.title: Open Source
program.motto: Build It. Test It. Publish It.
program.intro: Modeled after pioneering open-source silicon initiatives, the Optica Egypt Open Source initiative democratizes access to Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) design, simulation, and physical fabrication for Egyptian researchers, students, and engineers.
program.vision: Lowering entry barriers to optical chip design through open Python-based photonic design automation (PDA), open process design kits (PDKs), and collaborative tapeout partnerships.

pillars.title: Open PDA and Layout Automation
pillars.summary: Full design flows powered by open-source Python frameworks, algorithmic routing, and automated layout generation without costly proprietary licenses.

pillars.title: Open PDKs and Design Rules
pillars.summary: Promoting standard, community-verified Process Design Kits with verified optical parametric cells, waveguide bends, directional couplers, and grating couplers.

pillars.title: Egypt Photonic Chipathon
pillars.summary: An annual nationwide design contest where student and researcher teams design novel photonic circuits, undergo peer review, and compete for subsidized tapeout fabrication.

pillars.title: Reproducible Jupyter Notebooks
pillars.summary: Interactive tutorials teaching fundamental wave optics, finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation, and silicon photonic layout step by step.

pillars.title: Tapeout and Travel Fellowships
pillars.summary: Modeled after open-silicon grants, offering travel and characterization grants for Egyptian student teams to measure fabricated chips at partner laboratories.

pillars.title: Software-Defined Hackathon
pillars.summary: A flagship hackathon program to build software tools for photonics or AI models for photonics. Teams develop open-source simulation libraries, layout packages, and machine learning models for optical chip design.

toolstack.name: gdsfactory
toolstack.description: Python-driven photonic circuit design framework with built-in component models, DRC, and electrical-optical co-design support.

toolstack.name: Meep (FDTD)
toolstack.description: Open-source finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation software developed at MIT for modeling electromagnetic wave propagation.

toolstack.name: SiEPIC-Tools
toolstack.description: KLayout-based layout and verification package for silicon photonics, developed by the University of British Columbia.

toolstack.name: Femwell
toolstack.description: Finite element mode solver for optical waveguides and resonant structures written in Python.

chipathonTimeline.description: Introductory hands-on masterclasses covering gdsfactory, KLayout, and waveguide physics.
Teams submit design rule checked (DRC-clean) GDSII layouts with simulation verification.
Independent jury selects winning entries for multi-project wafer fabrication.
Fabricated dies are measured using optical probe stations at partner Egyptian laboratories.
